Updated the specs:
* moved from bal to block_access_list variabes (i remember this was suggested earler by <@892053833121923094> )
* move from using methods to a more C like function/structure

There's still the custom rlp encoding for the final block_access_list. Curious how to best handle it (if not as done in the specs right now).
